comparison.objective: Replace a CR2032 cell in a latched server socket, versus preassemble an ER32 collet and nut.
comparison.physical_skill: Release a latch, extract a disc, tilt a replacement under a fixed hook and press until latched; candidate aligns a groove at a marked eccentric ring and tilt-rolls it into continuous retention.
comparison.success_condition: Correct-polarity battery must be flat and latch lip closed, with old cell disposed; candidate requires collet retention for 3 seconds and a withdrawal check. Candidate lacks numeric snap/pull limits.
comparison.reason: There is partial tilt-and-latch similarity, but battery replacement tests hook-under insertion, polarity, removal and a separate latch rather than eccentric groove-to-ring engagement.
